CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_sweepstakes_for_breed_baseline(p_show_id uuid, p_breed_name text, p_scope text, p_show_letter text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS SETOF sweepstakes_results
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_letter text := upper(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_show_letter), ''), 'ALL'));
BEGIN
  IF upper(coalesce(p_scope, '')) NOT IN ('OPEN', 'YOUTH') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid scope: %. Expected OPEN or YOUTH.', p_scope;
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.sweepstakes_results sr
  WHERE sr.show_id = p_show_id
    AND sr.breed_name = p_breed_name
    AND upper(sr.scope) = upper(p_scope)
    AND upper(coalesce(sr.show_letter, 'ALL')) = v_letter
    AND sr.calculation_version = 'v2';

  DELETE FROM public.sweepstakes_entry_results ser
  WHERE ser.show_id = p_show_id
    AND ser.breed_name = p_breed_name
    AND upper(ser.scope) = upper(p_scope)
    AND upper(coalesce(ser.show_letter, 'ALL')) = v_letter;

  INSERT INTO public.sweepstakes_results (
    show_id,
    breed_name,
    exhibitor_id,
    exhibitor_name,
    scope,
    show_letter,
    class_points,
    variety_points,
    group_points,
    bob_points,
    bis_points,
    fur_points,
    total_points,
    calculation_version,
    rule_source,
    verification_status,
    engine_type
  )
  WITH matrix_rule AS (
    SELECT brm.*
    FROM public.breed_rules_matrix brm
    WHERE brm.breed_name = p_breed_name
      AND coalesce(brm.status, '') <> 'template'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  profile_rule AS (
    SELECT brp.*
    FROM public.breed_rules_profiles brp
    WHERE brp.breed_name = p_breed_name
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  result_rows AS (
    SELECT
      rer.entry_id,
      p_show_id AS show_id,
      rer.section_id,
      s.kind::text AS section_kind,
      concat(s.kind::text, ' ', s.letter::text) AS section_label,
      s.letter::text AS section_letter,
      rer.exhibitor_id::text AS exhibitor_id,
      rer.exhibitor_label AS exhibitor_name,
      rer.breed_name,
      rer.variety_name,
      rer.group_name,
      coalesce(rer.fur_variety, '') AS fur_variety,
      coalesce(rer.is_fur, false) AS is_fur,
      rer.sex,
      rer.class_name,
      rer.placement,
      CASE
        WHEN btrim(coalesce(rer.placement, '')) ~ '^\d+$'
          THEN btrim(rer.placement)::integer
        ELSE NULL
      END AS placement_num,
      rer.is_shown,
      rer.is_disqualified,
      rer.uses_group_awards,
      rer.uses_variety_awards
    FROM public.show_sections s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.report_results_entry_rows(
      p_show_id,
      s.id,
      p_show_letter
    ) rer
    WHERE s.show_id = p_show_id
      AND upper(s.kind::text) = upper(p_scope)
      AND p_show_letter IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(p_show_letter) <> ''
      AND rer.breed_name = p_breed_name
      AND upper(coalesce(s.letter::text, '')) = upper(p_show_letter)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      rer.entry_id,
      p_show_id AS show_id,
      rer.section_id,
      s.kind::text AS section_kind,
      concat(s.kind::text, ' ', s.letter::text) AS section_label,
      s.letter::text AS section_letter,
      rer.exhibitor_id::text AS exhibitor_id,
      rer.exhibitor_label AS exhibitor_name,
      rer.breed_name,
      rer.variety_name,
      rer.group_name,
      coalesce(rer.fur_variety, '') AS fur_variety,
      coalesce(rer.is_fur, false) AS is_fur,
      rer.sex,
      rer.class_name,
      rer.placement,
      CASE
        WHEN btrim(coalesce(rer.placement, '')) ~ '^\d+$'
          THEN btrim(rer.placement)::integer
        ELSE NULL
      END AS placement_num,
      rer.is_shown,
      rer.is_disqualified,
      rer.uses_group_awards,
      rer.uses_variety_awards
    FROM public.show_sections s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.report_results_entry_rows(
      p_show_id,
      s.id,
      p_show_letter
    ) rer
    WHERE s.show_id = p_show_id
      AND upper(s.kind::text) = upper(p_scope)
      AND (p_show_letter IS NULL OR btrim(p_show_letter) = '')
      AND rer.breed_name = p_breed_name
  ),
  eligible_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM result_rows
    WHERE coalesce(is_shown, true) = true
      AND coalesce(is_disqualified, false) = false
  ),
  regular_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible_rows
    WHERE coalesce(is_fur, false) = false
  ),
  fur_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible_rows
    WHERE coalesce(is_fur, false) = true
  ),
  class_counts AS (
    SELECT
      er.breed_name,
      er.variety_name,
      er.sex,
      er.class_name,
      er.section_id,
      count(*)::numeric AS entry_count,
      count(DISTINCT er.exhibitor_id)::numeric AS exhibitor_count
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name, er.variety_name, er.sex, er.class_name, er.section_id
  ),
  
  fur_class_counts AS (
    SELECT
      er.breed_name,
      nullif(btrim(er.fur_variety), '') AS fur_variety,
      er.section_id,
      count(*)::numeric AS entry_count,
      count(DISTINCT er.exhibitor_id)::numeric AS exhibitor_count
    FROM fur_rows er
    GROUP BY
      er.breed_name,
      nullif(btrim(er.fur_variety), ''),
      er.section_id
  ),

  breed_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, count(*)::numeric AS breed_total
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name
  ),
  sex_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, er.sex, count(*)::numeric AS sex_total
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name, er.sex
  ),
  variety_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, er.variety_name, count(*)::numeric AS variety_total
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name, er.variety_name
  ),
  group_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, er.group_name, count(*)::numeric AS group_total
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name, er.group_name
  ),
  show_totals AS (
    SELECT count(*)::numeric AS show_total
    FROM regular_rows
  ),
  wool_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, count(*)::numeric AS wool_total
    FROM fur_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name
  ),
  class_points_by_exhibitor AS (
    SELECT
      er.show_id,
      er.breed_name,
      er.exhibitor_id,
      max(er.exhibitor_name) AS exhibitor_name,
      upper(p_scope) AS scope,
      sum(
        (
          CASE er.placement_num
            WHEN 1 THEN coalesce(mr.place_1, 0)
            WHEN 2 THEN coalesce(mr.place_2, 0)
            WHEN 3 THEN coalesce(mr.place_3, 0)
            WHEN 4 THEN coalesce(mr.place_4, 0)
            WHEN 5 THEN coalesce(mr.place_5, 0)
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) *
        (
          CASE
            WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.class_points_model, 'MULTIPLIER_BY_CLASS_SIZE')) = 'FLAT_BY_PLACING' THEN 1
            WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.class_points_model, '')) = 'MULTIPLIER_BY_VARIETY_SIZE' THEN coalesce(vt.variety_total, 0)
            WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.multiplier_type, 'ENTRY_COUNT')) = 'EXHIBITOR_COUNT' THEN coalesce(cc.exhibitor_count, 0)
            ELSE coalesce(cc.entry_count, 0)
          END
        )
      )::numeric(10,2) AS class_points
    FROM regular_rows er
    LEFT JOIN matrix_rule mr ON true
    LEFT JOIN class_counts cc
      ON cc.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND cc.variety_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.variety_name
     AND cc.sex IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.sex
     AND cc.class_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.class_name
     AND cc.section_id = er.section_id
    LEFT JOIN variety_totals vt
      ON vt.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND vt.variety_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.variety_name
    WHERE er.placement_num BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    GROUP BY er.show_id, er.breed_name, er.exhibitor_id
  ),
  fur_class_points_by_exhibitor AS (
    SELECT
      er.show_id,
      er.breed_name,
      er.exhibitor_id,
      max(er.exhibitor_name) AS exhibitor_name,
      upper(p_scope) AS scope,
      sum(
        (
          CASE er.placement_num
            WHEN 1 THEN coalesce(mr.place_1, 0)
            WHEN 2 THEN coalesce(mr.place_2, 0)
            WHEN 3 THEN coalesce(mr.place_3, 0)
            WHEN 4 THEN coalesce(mr.place_4, 0)
            WHEN 5 THEN coalesce(mr.place_5, 0)
            ELSE 0
          END
        ) *
        (
          CASE
            WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.class_points_model, 'MULTIPLIER_BY_CLASS_SIZE')) = 'FLAT_BY_PLACING' THEN 1
            WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.multiplier_type, 'ENTRY_COUNT')) = 'EXHIBITOR_COUNT' THEN coalesce(fc.exhibitor_count, 0)
            ELSE coalesce(fc.entry_count, 0)
          END
        )
      )::numeric(10,2) AS fur_points
    FROM fur_rows er
    LEFT JOIN matrix_rule mr ON true
    
    LEFT JOIN fur_class_counts fc
      ON fc.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND fc.fur_variety IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
         nullif(btrim(er.fur_variety), '')
     AND fc.section_id = er.section_id

    WHERE er.placement_num BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    GROUP BY er.show_id, er.breed_name, er.exhibitor_id
  ),
  awards_union AS (
    SELECT
      e.show_id,
      ea.entry_id,
      upper(btrim(ea.award_code)) AS award_code
    FROM public.entry_awards ea
    JOIN public.entries e
      ON e.id = ea.entry_id
    WHERE e.show_id = p_show_id
      AND ea.award_code IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(ea.award_code) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT r.show_id, r.entry_id, upper(btrim(r.award)) AS award_code
    FROM public.results r
    WHERE r.show_id = p_show_id
      AND r.award IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(r.award) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT e.show_id, e.id AS entry_id, upper(btrim(e.special_awards)) AS award_code
    FROM public.entries e
    WHERE e.show_id = p_show_id
      AND e.special_awards IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(e.special_awards) <> ''
  ),
  award_points_by_exhibitor AS (
    SELECT
      er.show_id,
      er.breed_name,
      er.exhibitor_id,
      max(er.exhibitor_name) AS exhibitor_name,
      upper(p_scope) AS scope,

      sum(
        CASE
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_variety_points, false) = false THEN 0
          WHEN er.uses_variety_awards IS NOT TRUE THEN 0
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%BOV%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bov_basis, 'VARIETY_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'VARIETY_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bov_points, 0) * coalesce(vt.variety_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bov_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bov_points, 0)
            END
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%BOSV%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bosv_basis, 'VARIETY_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'VARIETY_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosv_points, 0) * coalesce(vt.variety_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosv_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bosv_points, 0)
            END
          ELSE 0
        END
      )::numeric(10,2) AS variety_points,

      sum(
        CASE
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_group_points, false) = false THEN 0
          WHEN er.uses_group_awards IS NOT TRUE THEN 0
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%BOG%' THEN coalesce(mr.bog_points, 0)
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%BOSG%' THEN coalesce(mr.bosg_points, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      )::numeric(10,2) AS group_points,

      sum(
        CASE
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_bob_points, true) = false THEN 0
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%BOB%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bob_basis, 'BREED_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0)
              WHEN 'SAME_SEX_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(st.sex_total, 0)
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT_ROUND_UP' THEN ceil(coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0))
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0)
            END
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%BOS%'
            AND au.award_code NOT LIKE '%BOSV%'
            AND au.award_code NOT LIKE '%BOSG%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bos_basis, 'BREED_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0)
              WHEN 'SAME_SEX_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(st.sex_total, 0)
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT_ROUND_UP' THEN ceil(coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0))
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0)
            END
          ELSE 0
        END
      )::numeric(10,2) AS bob_points,

      sum(
        CASE
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_bis_points, false) = false
           AND coalesce(mr.uses_best4class_points, false) = false
           AND coalesce(mr.uses_participation_points, false) = false
          THEN 0
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%BIS%' AND au.award_code NOT LIKE '%RIS%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bis_basis, 'FLAT'))
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT' THEN coalesce(nullif(mr.bis_points, 0), 1) * coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT_CAPPED' THEN least(coalesce(sht.show_total, 0), coalesce(nullif(mr.bis_points, 0), coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)))
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bis_points, 0)
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bis_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bis_points, 0)
            END
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%RIS%'
            OR au.award_code LIKE '%RBIS%'
            OR au.award_code LIKE '%BRIS%'
            OR au.award_code LIKE '%RESERVE%SHOW%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.ris_basis, 'FLAT'))
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT' THEN coalesce(nullif(mr.bris_points, 0), 1) * coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT_CAPPED' THEN least(coalesce(sht.show_total, 0), coalesce(nullif(mr.bris_points, 0), coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)))
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bris_points, 0)
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bris_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bris_points, 0)
            END
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_best4class_points, false) = true
           AND (
             au.award_code LIKE '%BEST 4%'
             OR au.award_code LIKE '%B4C%'
             OR au.award_code LIKE '%BEST 6 CLASS%'
           )
          THEN coalesce(mr.best4class_points, 0)
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_participation_points, false) = true
           AND (
             au.award_code LIKE '%PARTICIPATION%'
             OR au.award_code LIKE '%EXHIBIT%'
           )
          THEN coalesce(mr.participation_points, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
      )::numeric(10,2) AS bis_points,

      sum(
        CASE
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_fur_points, false) = false THEN 0
          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%FUR%' OR au.award_code LIKE '%WOOL%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.fur_basis, 'FLAT'))
              WHEN 'WOOL_ENTRY_COUNT' THEN coalesce(nullif(mr.fur_points, 0), 1) * coalesce(wt.wool_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.fur_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.fur_points, 0)
            END
          ELSE 0
        END
      )::numeric(10,2) AS fur_points

    FROM eligible_rows er
    JOIN awards_union au
      ON au.show_id = er.show_id
     AND au.entry_id = er.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN matrix_rule mr ON true
    LEFT JOIN breed_totals bt
      ON bt.breed_name = er.breed_name
    LEFT JOIN sex_totals st
      ON st.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND st.sex IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.sex
    LEFT JOIN variety_totals vt
      ON vt.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND vt.variety_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.variety_name
    LEFT JOIN group_totals gt
      ON gt.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND gt.group_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.group_name
    LEFT JOIN show_totals sht ON true
    LEFT JOIN wool_totals wt
      ON wt.breed_name = er.breed_name
    GROUP BY er.show_id, er.breed_name, er.exhibitor_id
  ),
  combined AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce(cp.show_id, ap.show_id, fp.show_id) AS show_id,
      coalesce(cp.breed_name, ap.breed_name, fp.breed_name) AS breed_name,
      coalesce(cp.exhibitor_id, ap.exhibitor_id, fp.exhibitor_id) AS exhibitor_id,
      coalesce(cp.exhibitor_name, ap.exhibitor_name, fp.exhibitor_name) AS exhibitor_name,
      upper(p_scope) AS scope,
      coalesce(cp.class_points, 0)::numeric(10,2) AS class_points,
      coalesce(ap.variety_points, 0)::numeric(10,2) AS variety_points,
      coalesce(ap.group_points, 0)::numeric(10,2) AS group_points,
      coalesce(ap.bob_points, 0)::numeric(10,2) AS bob_points,
      coalesce(ap.bis_points, 0)::numeric(10,2) AS bis_points,
      (
        coalesce(ap.fur_points, 0) +
        coalesce(fp.fur_points, 0)
      )::numeric(10,2) AS fur_points
    FROM class_points_by_exhibitor cp
    FULL OUTER JOIN award_points_by_exhibitor ap
      ON ap.show_id = cp.show_id
     AND ap.breed_name = cp.breed_name
     AND ap.exhibitor_id = cp.exhibitor_id
    FULL OUTER JOIN fur_class_points_by_exhibitor fp
      ON fp.show_id = coalesce(cp.show_id, ap.show_id)
     AND fp.breed_name = coalesce(cp.breed_name, ap.breed_name)
     AND fp.exhibitor_id = coalesce(cp.exhibitor_id, ap.exhibitor_id)
  )
  SELECT
    c.show_id,
    c.breed_name,
    c.exhibitor_id,
    c.exhibitor_name,
    c.scope,
    v_letter,
    c.class_points,
    c.variety_points,
    c.group_points,
    c.bob_points,
    c.bis_points,
    c.fur_points,
    (
      c.class_points
      + c.variety_points
      + c.group_points
      + c.bob_points
      + c.bis_points
      + c.fur_points
    )::numeric(10,2) AS total_points,
    'v2' AS calculation_version,
    coalesce(pr.rule_source, 'DEFAULT')::text,
    coalesce(pr.verification_status, 'PROVISIONAL')::text,
    coalesce(pr.engine_type, 'ADDITIVE_LIGHT')::text
  FROM combined c
  LEFT JOIN profile_rule pr ON true
  WHERE c.exhibitor_id IS NOT NULL;

  INSERT INTO public.sweepstakes_entry_results (
    show_id,
    exhibitor_id,
    entry_id,
    animal_id,
    breed_name,
    variety_name,
    class_name,
    sex,
    tattoo,
    show_letter,
    scope,
    points_source,
    points
  )
  WITH matrix_rule AS (
    SELECT brm.*
    FROM public.breed_rules_matrix brm
    WHERE brm.breed_name = p_breed_name
      AND coalesce(brm.status, '') <> 'template'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  result_rows AS (
    SELECT
      rer.entry_id,
      NULL::uuid AS animal_id,
      p_show_id AS show_id,
      rer.section_id,
      s.letter::text AS section_letter,
      rer.exhibitor_id::text AS exhibitor_id,
      rer.breed_name,
      rer.variety_name,
      rer.group_name,
      coalesce(rer.fur_variety, '') AS fur_variety,
      coalesce(rer.is_fur, false) AS is_fur,
      rer.sex,
      rer.class_name,
      rer.tattoo,
      rer.placement,
      CASE
        WHEN btrim(coalesce(rer.placement, '')) ~ '^\d+$'
          THEN btrim(rer.placement)::integer
        ELSE NULL
      END AS placement_num,
      rer.is_shown,
      rer.is_disqualified,
      rer.uses_group_awards,
      rer.uses_variety_awards
    FROM public.show_sections s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.report_results_entry_rows(p_show_id, s.id, p_show_letter) rer
    WHERE s.show_id = p_show_id
      AND upper(s.kind::text) = upper(p_scope)
      AND p_show_letter IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(p_show_letter) <> ''
      AND rer.breed_name = p_breed_name
      AND upper(coalesce(s.letter::text, '')) = upper(p_show_letter)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      rer.entry_id,
      NULL::uuid AS animal_id,
      p_show_id AS show_id,
      rer.section_id,
      s.letter::text AS section_letter,
      rer.exhibitor_id::text AS exhibitor_id,
      rer.breed_name,
      rer.variety_name,
      rer.group_name,
      coalesce(rer.fur_variety, '') AS fur_variety,
      coalesce(rer.is_fur, false) AS is_fur,
      rer.sex,
      rer.class_name,
      rer.tattoo,
      rer.placement,
      CASE
        WHEN btrim(coalesce(rer.placement, '')) ~ '^\d+$'
          THEN btrim(rer.placement)::integer
        ELSE NULL
      END AS placement_num,
      rer.is_shown,
      rer.is_disqualified,
      rer.uses_group_awards,
      rer.uses_variety_awards
    FROM public.show_sections s
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.report_results_entry_rows(p_show_id, s.id, p_show_letter) rer
    WHERE s.show_id = p_show_id
      AND upper(s.kind::text) = upper(p_scope)
      AND (p_show_letter IS NULL OR btrim(p_show_letter) = '')
      AND rer.breed_name = p_breed_name
  ),
  eligible_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM result_rows
    WHERE coalesce(is_shown, true) = true
      AND coalesce(is_disqualified, false) = false
  ),
  regular_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible_rows
    WHERE coalesce(is_fur, false) = false
  ),
  fur_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible_rows
    WHERE coalesce(is_fur, false) = true
  ),
  class_counts AS (
    SELECT
      er.breed_name,
      er.variety_name,
      er.sex,
      er.class_name,
      er.section_id,
      count(*)::numeric AS entry_count,
      count(DISTINCT er.exhibitor_id)::numeric AS exhibitor_count
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name, er.variety_name, er.sex, er.class_name, er.section_id
  ),
  
  fur_class_counts AS (
    SELECT
      er.breed_name,
      nullif(btrim(er.fur_variety), '') AS fur_variety,
      er.section_id,
      count(*)::numeric AS entry_count,
      count(DISTINCT er.exhibitor_id)::numeric AS exhibitor_count
    FROM fur_rows er
    GROUP BY
      er.breed_name,
      nullif(btrim(er.fur_variety), ''),
      er.section_id
  ),

  breed_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, count(*)::numeric AS breed_total
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name
  ),
  sex_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, er.sex, count(*)::numeric AS sex_total
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name, er.sex
  ),
  show_totals AS (
    SELECT count(*)::numeric AS show_total
    FROM regular_rows
  ),
  variety_totals AS (
    SELECT er.breed_name, er.variety_name, count(*)::numeric AS variety_total
    FROM regular_rows er
    GROUP BY er.breed_name, er.variety_name
  ),
  awards_union AS (
    SELECT
      e.show_id,
      ea.entry_id,
      upper(btrim(ea.award_code)) AS award_code
    FROM public.entry_awards ea
    JOIN public.entries e
      ON e.id = ea.entry_id
    WHERE e.show_id = p_show_id
      AND ea.award_code IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(ea.award_code) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT r.show_id, r.entry_id, upper(btrim(r.award)) AS award_code
    FROM public.results r
    WHERE r.show_id = p_show_id
      AND r.award IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(r.award) <> ''

    UNION

    SELECT e.show_id, e.id AS entry_id, upper(btrim(e.special_awards)) AS award_code
    FROM public.entries e
    WHERE e.show_id = p_show_id
      AND e.special_awards IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim(e.special_awards) <> ''
  ),
  entry_points AS (
    SELECT
      er.show_id,
      er.exhibitor_id,
      er.entry_id,
      er.animal_id,
      
      er.breed_name,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) THEN
          CASE
            WHEN btrim(coalesce(er.fur_variety, '')) = ''
              THEN 'Wool'
            WHEN lower(btrim(er.fur_variety)) IN ('white', 'white wool')
              THEN 'Wool - White'
            WHEN lower(btrim(er.fur_variety)) IN (
              'colored',
              'coloured',
              'colored wool',
              'coloured wool'
            )
              THEN 'Wool - Colored'
            WHEN lower(btrim(er.fur_variety)) LIKE 'wool - %'
              THEN initcap(btrim(er.fur_variety))
            ELSE 'Wool - ' || initcap(btrim(er.fur_variety))
          END
        ELSE er.variety_name
      END AS variety_name,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) THEN ''
        ELSE er.class_name
      END AS class_name,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) THEN ''
        ELSE er.sex
      END AS sex,
      er.tattoo,
      coalesce(er.section_letter, v_letter) AS show_letter,

      upper(p_scope) AS scope,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) THEN 'FUR'
        ELSE 'CLASS'
      END AS points_source,
      (
        CASE er.placement_num
          WHEN 1 THEN coalesce(mr.place_1, 0)
          WHEN 2 THEN coalesce(mr.place_2, 0)
          WHEN 3 THEN coalesce(mr.place_3, 0)
          WHEN 4 THEN coalesce(mr.place_4, 0)
          WHEN 5 THEN coalesce(mr.place_5, 0)
          ELSE 0
        END
        *
        CASE
          WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.class_points_model, 'MULTIPLIER_BY_CLASS_SIZE')) = 'FLAT_BY_PLACING' THEN 1
          WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) = true THEN
            CASE
              WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.multiplier_type, 'ENTRY_COUNT')) = 'EXHIBITOR_COUNT' THEN coalesce(fc.exhibitor_count, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(fc.entry_count, 0)
            END
          WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.class_points_model, '')) = 'MULTIPLIER_BY_VARIETY_SIZE' THEN coalesce(vt.variety_total, 0)
          WHEN upper(coalesce(mr.multiplier_type, 'ENTRY_COUNT')) = 'EXHIBITOR_COUNT' THEN coalesce(cc.exhibitor_count, 0)
          ELSE coalesce(cc.entry_count, 0)
        END
      )::numeric(10,2) AS points
    FROM eligible_rows er
    LEFT JOIN matrix_rule mr ON true
    LEFT JOIN class_counts cc
      ON cc.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND cc.variety_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.variety_name
     AND cc.sex IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.sex
     AND cc.class_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.class_name
     AND cc.section_id = er.section_id
    
    LEFT JOIN fur_class_counts fc
      ON fc.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND fc.fur_variety IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
         nullif(btrim(er.fur_variety), '')
     AND fc.section_id = er.section_id

    LEFT JOIN variety_totals vt
      ON vt.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND vt.variety_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.variety_name
    WHERE er.placement_num BETWEEN 1 AND 5

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
      er.show_id,
      er.exhibitor_id,
      er.entry_id,
      er.animal_id,
      
      er.breed_name,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) THEN
          CASE
            WHEN btrim(coalesce(er.fur_variety, '')) = ''
              THEN 'Wool'
            WHEN lower(btrim(er.fur_variety)) IN ('white', 'white wool')
              THEN 'Wool - White'
            WHEN lower(btrim(er.fur_variety)) IN (
              'colored',
              'coloured',
              'colored wool',
              'coloured wool'
            )
              THEN 'Wool - Colored'
            WHEN lower(btrim(er.fur_variety)) LIKE 'wool - %'
              THEN initcap(btrim(er.fur_variety))
            ELSE 'Wool - ' || initcap(btrim(er.fur_variety))
          END
        ELSE er.variety_name
      END AS variety_name,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) THEN ''
        ELSE er.class_name
      END AS class_name,
      CASE
        WHEN coalesce(er.is_fur, false) THEN ''
        ELSE er.sex
      END AS sex,
      er.tattoo,
      coalesce(er.section_letter, v_letter) AS show_letter,

      upper(p_scope) AS scope,
      au.award_code AS points_source,
      (
        CASE
          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_variety_points, false) = true
            AND er.uses_variety_awards IS true
            AND au.award_code LIKE '%BOV%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bov_basis, 'VARIETY_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'VARIETY_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bov_points, 0) * coalesce(vt.variety_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bov_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bov_points, 0)
            END

          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_variety_points, false) = true
            AND er.uses_variety_awards IS true
            AND au.award_code LIKE '%BOSV%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bosv_basis, 'VARIETY_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'VARIETY_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosv_points, 0) * coalesce(vt.variety_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosv_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bosv_points, 0)
            END

          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_group_points, false) = true
            AND er.uses_group_awards IS true
            AND au.award_code LIKE '%BOG%' THEN
            coalesce(mr.bog_points, 0)

          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_group_points, false) = true
            AND er.uses_group_awards IS true
            AND au.award_code LIKE '%BOSG%' THEN
            coalesce(mr.bosg_points, 0)

          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_bob_points, true) = true
            AND au.award_code LIKE '%BOB%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bob_basis, 'BREED_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0)
              WHEN 'SAME_SEX_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(st.sex_total, 0)
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT_ROUND_UP' THEN ceil(coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0))
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0) * coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bob_points, 0)
            END

          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_bob_points, true) = true
            AND au.award_code LIKE '%BOS%'
            AND au.award_code NOT LIKE '%BOSV%'
            AND au.award_code NOT LIKE '%BOSG%' THEN
            CASE upper(coalesce(mr.bos_basis, 'BREED_COUNT'))
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0)
              WHEN 'SAME_SEX_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(st.sex_total, 0)
              WHEN 'BREED_COUNT_ROUND_UP' THEN ceil(coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(bt.breed_total, 0))
              WHEN 'SHOW_COUNT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0) * coalesce(sht.show_total, 0)
              WHEN 'FLAT' THEN coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0)
              ELSE coalesce(mr.bosb_points, 0)
            END

          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_bis_points, false) = true
            AND au.award_code LIKE '%BIS%'
            AND au.award_code NOT LIKE '%RIS%' THEN
            coalesce(mr.bis_points, 0)

          WHEN au.award_code LIKE '%RIS%'
            OR au.award_code LIKE '%RBIS%'
            OR au.award_code LIKE '%BRIS%'
            OR au.award_code LIKE '%RESERVE%SHOW%' THEN
            coalesce(mr.bris_points, 0)

          WHEN coalesce(mr.uses_fur_points, false) = true
            AND (au.award_code LIKE '%FUR%' OR au.award_code LIKE '%WOOL%') THEN
            coalesce(mr.fur_points, 0)

          ELSE 0
        END
      )::numeric(10,2) AS points
    FROM eligible_rows er
    JOIN awards_union au
      ON au.show_id = er.show_id
     AND au.entry_id = er.entry_id
    LEFT JOIN matrix_rule mr ON true
    LEFT JOIN breed_totals bt
      ON bt.breed_name = er.breed_name
    LEFT JOIN variety_totals vt
      ON vt.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND vt.variety_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.variety_name
    LEFT JOIN sex_totals st
      ON st.breed_name = er.breed_name
     AND st.sex IS NOT DISTINCT FROM er.sex
    LEFT JOIN show_totals sht ON true
  )
  SELECT
    show_id,
    exhibitor_id,
    entry_id,
    animal_id,
    breed_name,
    variety_name,
    class_name,
    sex,
    tattoo,
    show_letter,
    scope,
    points_source,
    sum(points)::numeric(10,2) AS points
  FROM entry_points
  WHERE points <> 0
  GROUP BY
    show_id,
    exhibitor_id,
    entry_id,
    animal_id,
    breed_name,
    variety_name,
    class_name,
    sex,
    tattoo,
    show_letter,
    scope,
    points_source;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT sr.*
  FROM public.sweepstakes_results sr
  WHERE sr.show_id = p_show_id
    AND sr.breed_name = p_breed_name
    AND upper(sr.scope) = upper(p_scope)
    AND upper(coalesce(sr.show_letter, 'ALL')) = v_letter
    AND sr.calculation_version = 'v2'
  ORDER BY sr.total_points DESC, sr.exhibitor_name ASC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_sweepstakes_for_show(p_show_id uuid, p_scope text, p_show_letter text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS SETOF sweepstakes_results
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$declare
  v_breed record;
  v_letter text := upper(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_show_letter), ''), 'ALL'));
begin
  if upper(coalesce(p_scope, '')) not in ('OPEN', 'YOUTH') then
    raise exception 'Invalid scope: %. Expected OPEN or YOUTH.', p_scope;
  end if;

  delete from public.sweepstakes_results sr
  where sr.show_id = p_show_id
    and upper(sr.scope) = upper(p_scope)
    and upper(coalesce(sr.show_letter, 'ALL')) = v_letter
    and sr.calculation_version = 'v2';

  for v_breed in

    -- specific letter path
    select distinct rer.breed_name
    from public.show_sections s
    cross join lateral public.report_results_entry_rows(
      p_show_id,
      s.id,
      null
    ) rer
    where s.show_id = p_show_id
      and upper(s.kind::text) = upper(p_scope)
      and p_show_letter is not null
      and btrim(p_show_letter) <> ''
      and rer.breed_name is not null
      and btrim(rer.breed_name) <> ''
      and upper(coalesce(s.letter::text, '')) = upper(p_show_letter)

    union

    -- all letters path
    select distinct rer.breed_name
    from public.show_sections s
    cross join lateral public.report_results_entry_rows(
      p_show_id,
      s.id,
      null
    ) rer
    where s.show_id = p_show_id
      and upper(s.kind::text) = upper(p_scope)
      and (p_show_letter is null or btrim(p_show_letter) = '')
      and rer.breed_name is not null
      and btrim(rer.breed_name) <> ''

    order by 1

  loop
    perform public.calculate_sweepstakes_for_breed(
      p_show_id,
      v_breed.breed_name,
      upper(p_scope),
      p_show_letter
    );
  end loop;

  return query
  select sr.*
  from public.sweepstakes_results sr
  where sr.show_id = p_show_id
    and upper(sr.scope) = upper(p_scope)
    and upper(coalesce(sr.show_letter, 'ALL')) = v_letter
    and sr.calculation_version = 'v2'
  order by sr.breed_name asc, sr.total_points desc, sr.exhibitor_name asc;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_entry_cart_balance_internal(p_cart_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF show_exhibitor_balances
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_show_id uuid;
  v_enabled boolean := false;
  v_type text := 'amount';
  v_value numeric := 0;
  v_scope text := 'both';
  v_show_letters text[] := '{}'::text[];
begin
  perform 1
  from public.calculate_entry_cart_balance_without_canada_special(p_cart_id);

  select c.show_id
  into v_show_id
  from public.entry_carts c
  where c.id = p_cart_id;

  select
    coalesce(sfs.canada_special_discount_enabled, false),
    lower(coalesce(sfs.canada_special_discount_type, 'amount')),
    greatest(coalesce(sfs.canada_special_discount_value, 0), 0),
    lower(coalesce(sfs.canada_special_discount_scope, 'both')),
    coalesce(sfs.canada_special_show_letters, '{}'::text[])
  into v_enabled, v_type, v_value, v_scope, v_show_letters
  from public.show_fee_settings sfs
  where sfs.show_id = v_show_id;

  if coalesce(v_enabled, false) then
    with canada_discount_by_exhibitor as (
      select
        eci.exhibitor_id,
        round(
          sum(
            least(
              coalesce(sffs.fee_per_entry, 0),
              greatest(
                case
                  when v_type = 'fixed_rate' then
                    coalesce(sffs.fee_per_entry, 0) - v_value
                  when v_type = 'percent' then
                    coalesce(sffs.fee_per_entry, 0)
                    * case when v_value <= 1 then v_value else v_value / 100 end
                  when v_type = 'amount' then v_value
                  else 0
                end,
                0
              )
            )
          ) * 100
        )::integer as special_discount_cents
      from public.entry_cart_items eci
      join public.exhibitors exhibitor
        on exhibitor.id = eci.exhibitor_id
      join public.show_sections section
        on section.id = eci.section_id
       and section.show_id = v_show_id
      left join public.show_section_fee_settings sffs
        on sffs.section_id = eci.section_id
      where eci.cart_id = p_cart_id
        and not coalesce(eci.is_fur, false)
        and public.is_canadian_exhibitor_address(
          exhibitor.state,
          exhibitor.zip
        )
        and (
          v_scope = 'both'
          or lower(section.kind::text) = v_scope
        )
        and (
          cardinality(v_show_letters) = 0
          or exists (
            select 1
            from unnest(v_show_letters) as selected_letter
            where upper(btrim(selected_letter)) = upper(btrim(section.letter))
          )
        )
      group by eci.exhibitor_id
    ), chosen_discounts as (
      select
        balance.id,
        balance.discount_cents as volume_discount_cents,
        greatest(
          balance.discount_cents,
          canada.special_discount_cents
        )::integer as chosen_discount_cents,
        canada.special_discount_cents
      from public.show_exhibitor_balances balance
      join canada_discount_by_exhibitor canada
        on canada.exhibitor_id = balance.exhibitor_id
      where balance.entry_cart_id = p_cart_id
        and balance.source = 'cart'
    )
    update public.show_exhibitor_balances balance
    set
      discount_cents = chosen.chosen_discount_cents,
      calculated_total_cents = greatest(
        balance.subtotal_before_discount_cents - chosen.chosen_discount_cents,
        0
      ),
      balance_due_cents = greatest(
        balance.subtotal_before_discount_cents
          - chosen.chosen_discount_cents
          - balance.paid_online_cents
          - balance.paid_manual_cents
          + balance.refunded_cents,
        0
      ),
      payment_status = case
        when greatest(
          balance.subtotal_before_discount_cents
            - chosen.chosen_discount_cents
            - balance.paid_online_cents
            - balance.paid_manual_cents
            + balance.refunded_cents,
          0
        ) = 0 then 'paid'
        else 'unpaid'
      end,
      fee_snapshot = coalesce(balance.fee_snapshot, '{}'::jsonb)
        || jsonb_build_object(
          'discount_strategy', 'better_discount',
          'volume_discount_cents', chosen.volume_discount_cents,
          'special_discount_eligible', true,
          'special_discount_cents', chosen.special_discount_cents,
          'applied_discount', case
            when chosen.special_discount_cents > chosen.volume_discount_cents
              then 'special'
            when chosen.volume_discount_cents > 0 then 'volume'
            else 'none'
          end,
          'discount_cents', chosen.chosen_discount_cents,
          'calculated_total_cents', greatest(
            balance.subtotal_before_discount_cents
              - chosen.chosen_discount_cents,
            0
          )
        ),
      calculated_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()
    from chosen_discounts chosen
    where balance.id = chosen.id;
  end if;

  return query
  select balance.*
  from public.show_exhibitor_balances balance
  where balance.entry_cart_id = p_cart_id
    and balance.source = 'cart'
  order by balance.exhibitor_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calculate_entry_cart_balance_without_canada_special(p_cart_id uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF show_exhibitor_balances
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_show_id uuid;
  v_cart_user_id uuid;

  v_currency text := 'usd';

  v_discount_enabled boolean := false;
  v_discount_type text := 'amount';
  v_discount_value numeric := 0;

  v_discount_basis text := 'each_show';
  v_discount_scope text := 'both';
  v_discount_min_entries integer := 0;
  v_discount_max_entries integer := null;
  v_discount_required_shows integer := 0;
begin
  select
    c.show_id,
    c.user_id
  into
    v_show_id,
    v_cart_user_id
  from public.entry_carts c
  where c.id = p_cart_id;

  if v_show_id is null then
    raise exception 'Cart % not found', p_cart_id;
  end if;

  select
    lower(coalesce(sfs.currency, 'usd')),
    coalesce(sfs.multi_show_discount_enabled, false),
    lower(coalesce(sfs.multi_show_discount_type, 'amount')),
    coalesce(sfs.multi_show_discount_value, 0),
    lower(coalesce(sfs.multi_show_discount_basis, 'each_show')),
    lower(coalesce(sfs.multi_show_discount_scope, 'both')),
    coalesce(sfs.multi_show_discount_min_entries, 0),
    sfs.multi_show_discount_max_entries,
    coalesce(sfs.multi_show_discount_required_shows, 0)
  into
    v_currency,
    v_discount_enabled,
    v_discount_type,
    v_discount_value,
    v_discount_basis,
    v_discount_scope,
    v_discount_min_entries,
    v_discount_max_entries,
    v_discount_required_shows
  from public.show_fee_settings sfs
  where sfs.show_id = v_show_id;

  -- Apply safe defaults when the show has no fee-settings row.
  if not found then
    v_currency := 'usd';
    v_discount_enabled := false;
    v_discount_type := 'amount';
    v_discount_value := 0;
    v_discount_basis := 'each_show';
    v_discount_scope := 'both';
    v_discount_min_entries := 0;
    v_discount_max_entries := null;
    v_discount_required_shows := 0;
  end if;

  if length(v_currency) <> 3 then
    v_currency := 'usd';
  end if;

  if v_discount_type not in ('fixed_rate', 'amount', 'percent') then
    v_discount_type := 'amount';
  end if;

  if v_discount_basis not in ('each_show', 'cumulative') then
    v_discount_basis := 'each_show';
  end if;

  if v_discount_scope not in ('both', 'open', 'youth') then
    v_discount_scope := 'both';
  end if;

  v_discount_value := greatest(coalesce(v_discount_value, 0), 0);
  v_discount_min_entries :=
    greatest(coalesce(v_discount_min_entries, 0), 0);
  v_discount_required_shows :=
    greatest(coalesce(v_discount_required_shows, 0), 0);

  if v_discount_max_entries is not null then
    v_discount_max_entries :=
      greatest(v_discount_max_entries, 0);
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.entry_cart_items eci
    where eci.cart_id = p_cart_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Cart % is empty', p_cart_id;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.entry_cart_items eci
    where eci.cart_id = p_cart_id
      and eci.exhibitor_id is null
  ) then
    raise exception
      'Cart % has one or more items missing exhibitor_id',
      p_cart_id;
  end if;

  return query
  with cart_items as (
    select
      eci.id,
      eci.cart_id,
      eci.section_id,
      eci.animal_id,
      eci.exhibitor_id,
      coalesce(eci.is_fur, false) as is_fur,
      eci.created_at
    from public.entry_cart_items eci
    where eci.cart_id = p_cart_id
      and eci.exhibitor_id is not null
  ),

  priced_items as (
    select
      ci.*,
      ss.show_id,
      lower(ss.kind::text) as section_kind,
      ss.letter as section_letter,
      coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(ss.display_name), ''),
        concat(
          initcap(ss.kind::text),
          ' ',
          coalesce(ss.letter, '')
        )
      ) as section_label,
      ss.sort_order as section_sort_order,

      coalesce(sffs.fee_per_entry, 0)::numeric
        as fee_per_entry,

      coalesce(sffs.fee_per_show, 0)::numeric
        as fee_per_show,

      coalesce(sffs.fur_fee, 0)::numeric
        as fur_fee,

      case
        when v_discount_scope = 'both' then true
        when lower(ss.kind::text) = v_discount_scope then true
        else false
      end as eligible_for_discount

    from cart_items ci

    join public.show_sections ss
      on ss.id = ci.section_id

    left join public.show_section_fee_settings sffs
      on sffs.section_id = ci.section_id

    where ss.show_id = v_show_id
  ),

  /*
   * All section totals remain included in the balance, regardless of whether
   * the section is eligible for the selected discount scope.
   */
  section_counts as (
    select
      pi.exhibitor_id,
      pi.section_id,

      min(pi.section_kind) as section_kind,
      min(pi.section_letter) as section_letter,
      min(pi.section_label) as section_label,

      min(
        coalesce(pi.section_sort_order, 999999)
      ) as section_sort_order,

      count(*) filter (where not pi.is_fur)::integer as entry_count,

      count(*) filter (
        where pi.is_fur
      )::integer as fur_count,

      round(
        sum(case when not pi.is_fur then pi.fee_per_entry else 0 end) * 100
      )::integer as entries_subtotal_cents,

      round(
        sum(
          case
            when pi.is_fur then pi.fur_fee
            else 0
          end
        ) * 100
      )::integer as fur_subtotal_cents,

      round(
        max(pi.fee_per_show) * 100
      )::integer as show_fee_cents

    from priced_items pi

    group by
      pi.exhibitor_id,
      pi.section_id
  ),

  /*
   * Counts only sections permitted by multi_show_discount_scope.
   */
  eligible_section_counts as (
    select
      pi.exhibitor_id,
      pi.section_id,
      count(*) filter (where not pi.is_fur)::integer as eligible_entry_count

    from priced_items pi

    where pi.eligible_for_discount = true
      and not pi.is_fur

    group by
      pi.exhibitor_id,
      pi.section_id
  ),

  /*
   * Determines whether each exhibitor qualifies.
   *
   * each_show:
   *   At least the configured number of sections must each contain the
   *   configured minimum number of entries.
   *
   * cumulative:
   *   The exhibitor must enter at least the configured number of sections
   *   and have at least the configured total number of eligible entries.
   */
  exhibitor_discount_stats as (
    select
      pi.exhibitor_id,

      count(*) filter (
        where pi.eligible_for_discount
          and not pi.is_fur
      )::integer as eligible_entry_count,

      count(
        distinct pi.section_id
      ) filter (
        where pi.eligible_for_discount
      )::integer as eligible_show_count,

      coalesce((
        select count(*)::integer
        from eligible_section_counts esc
        where esc.exhibitor_id = pi.exhibitor_id
          and esc.eligible_entry_count >= v_discount_min_entries
      ), 0) as qualifying_show_count

    from priced_items pi

    group by pi.exhibitor_id
  ),

  /*
   * Add deterministic numbering so an optional maximum can be applied.
   *
   * For cumulative discounts, maximum entries is applied across all eligible
   * entries for the exhibitor.
   *
   * For each-show discounts, maximum entries is applied separately to each
   * qualifying show section, matching the cart-screen calculation.
   */
  eligible_ranked_items as (
    select
      pi.*,

      row_number() over (
        partition by pi.exhibitor_id
        order by
          pi.created_at,
          pi.id
      ) as cumulative_entry_number,

      row_number() over (
        partition by
          pi.exhibitor_id,
          pi.section_id
        order by
          pi.created_at,
          pi.id
      ) as section_entry_number

    from priced_items pi

    where pi.eligible_for_discount = true
      and not pi.is_fur
  ),

  discount_eligible_items as (
    select eri.*

    from eligible_ranked_items eri

    join exhibitor_discount_stats eds
      on eds.exhibitor_id = eri.exhibitor_id

    join eligible_section_counts esc
      on esc.exhibitor_id = eri.exhibitor_id
     and esc.section_id = eri.section_id

    where
      v_discount_enabled = true

      and v_discount_min_entries > 0

      and v_discount_required_shows > 0

      and (
        (
          v_discount_basis = 'cumulative'

          and eds.eligible_show_count
            >= v_discount_required_shows

          and eds.eligible_entry_count
            >= v_discount_min_entries

          and (
            v_discount_max_entries is null
            or eri.cumulative_entry_number
              <= v_discount_max_entries
          )
        )

        or

        (
          v_discount_basis = 'each_show'

          and eds.qualifying_show_count
            >= v_discount_required_shows

          and esc.eligible_entry_count
            >= v_discount_min_entries

          and (
            v_discount_max_entries is null
            or eri.section_entry_number
              <= v_discount_max_entries
          )
        )
      )
  ),

  /*
   * Calculate the discount one item at a time so differing section entry
   * fees are handled correctly.
   */
  exhibitor_discount_totals as (
    select
      dei.exhibitor_id,

      count(*)::integer as qualifying_entry_count,

      count(
        distinct dei.section_id
      )::integer as discounted_show_count,

      round(
        sum(
          least(
            dei.fee_per_entry,

            greatest(
              case
                when v_discount_type = 'fixed_rate' then
                  dei.fee_per_entry - v_discount_value

                when v_discount_type = 'percent' then
                  dei.fee_per_entry
                  *
                  case
                    when v_discount_value <= 1 then
                      v_discount_value
                    else
                      v_discount_value / 100.0
                  end

                when v_discount_type = 'amount' then
                  v_discount_value

                else 0
              end,
              0
            )
          )
        ) * 100
      )::integer as discount_cents

    from discount_eligible_items dei

    group by dei.exhibitor_id
  ),

  exhibitor_totals_raw as (
    select
      pi.exhibitor_id,

      count(*) filter (where not pi.is_fur)::integer as entry_count,

      count(*) filter (
        where pi.is_fur
      )::integer as fur_count,

      round(
        sum(case when not pi.is_fur then pi.fee_per_entry else 0 end) * 100
      )::integer as entries_subtotal_cents,

      round(
        sum(
          case
            when pi.is_fur then pi.fur_fee
            else 0
          end
        ) * 100
      )::integer as fur_subtotal_cents,

      coalesce((
        select sum(sc.show_fee_cents)::integer
        from section_counts sc
        where sc.exhibitor_id = pi.exhibitor_id
      ), 0) as show_fee_subtotal_cents,

      coalesce(
        eds.eligible_entry_count,
        0
      )::integer as eligible_entry_count,

      coalesce(
        eds.eligible_show_count,
        0
      )::integer as eligible_show_count,

      coalesce(
        eds.qualifying_show_count,
        0
      )::integer as qualifying_show_count,

      coalesce(
        edt.qualifying_entry_count,
        0
      )::integer as qualifying_entry_count,

      coalesce(
        edt.discounted_show_count,
        0
      )::integer as discounted_show_count,

      greatest(
        coalesce(edt.discount_cents, 0),
        0
      )::integer as discount_cents

    from priced_items pi

    left join exhibitor_discount_stats eds
      on eds.exhibitor_id = pi.exhibitor_id

    left join exhibitor_discount_totals edt
      on edt.exhibitor_id = pi.exhibitor_id

    group by
      pi.exhibitor_id,
      eds.eligible_entry_count,
      eds.eligible_show_count,
      eds.qualifying_show_count,
      edt.qualifying_entry_count,
      edt.discounted_show_count,
      edt.discount_cents
  ),

  exhibitor_totals as (
    select
      etr.*,

      (
        etr.entries_subtotal_cents
        + etr.fur_subtotal_cents
        + etr.show_fee_subtotal_cents
      )::integer as subtotal_before_discount_cents

    from exhibitor_totals_raw etr
  ),

  final_rows as (
    select
      et.exhibitor_id,

      coalesce(
        ex.owner_user_id,
        v_cart_user_id
      ) as exhibitor_user_id,

      et.entry_count,
      et.fur_count,
      et.entries_subtotal_cents,
      et.fur_subtotal_cents,
      et.show_fee_subtotal_cents,
      et.subtotal_before_discount_cents,

      least(
        greatest(et.discount_cents, 0),
        et.entries_subtotal_cents
      )::integer as discount_cents,

      greatest(
        et.subtotal_before_discount_cents
        - least(
            greatest(et.discount_cents, 0),
            et.entries_subtotal_cents
          ),
        0
      )::integer as calculated_total_cents,

      coalesce((
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'section_id', sc.section_id,
            'kind', sc.section_kind,
            'letter', sc.section_letter,
            'label', sc.section_label,
            'entry_count', sc.entry_count,
            'fur_count', sc.fur_count,
            'entries_subtotal_cents',
              sc.entries_subtotal_cents,
            'fur_subtotal_cents',
              sc.fur_subtotal_cents,
            'show_fee_cents',
              sc.show_fee_cents,
            'discount_scope_eligible',
              case
                when v_discount_scope = 'both' then true
                when lower(sc.section_kind) = v_discount_scope then true
                else false
              end
          )
          order by
            sc.section_sort_order,
            sc.section_kind,
            sc.section_letter
        )
        from section_counts sc
        where sc.exhibitor_id = et.exhibitor_id
      ), '[]'::jsonb) as section_breakdown,

      jsonb_build_object(
        'source', 'cart',
        'cart_id', p_cart_id,
        'show_id', v_show_id,
        'currency', v_currency,

        'discount_enabled', v_discount_enabled,
        'discount_type', v_discount_type,
        'discount_value', v_discount_value,
        'discount_basis', v_discount_basis,
        'discount_scope', v_discount_scope,
        'discount_min_entries', v_discount_min_entries,
        'discount_max_entries', v_discount_max_entries,
        'discount_required_shows', v_discount_required_shows,

        'eligible_entry_count',
          et.eligible_entry_count,
        'eligible_show_count',
          et.eligible_show_count,
        'qualifying_show_count',
          et.qualifying_show_count,
        'qualifying_entry_count',
          et.qualifying_entry_count,
        'discounted_show_count',
          et.discounted_show_count,

        'entry_count', et.entry_count,
        'fur_count', et.fur_count,

        'entries_subtotal_cents',
          et.entries_subtotal_cents,

        'fur_subtotal_cents',
          et.fur_subtotal_cents,

        'show_fee_subtotal_cents',
          et.show_fee_subtotal_cents,

        'subtotal_before_discount_cents',
          et.subtotal_before_discount_cents,

        'discount_cents',
          least(
            greatest(et.discount_cents, 0),
            et.entries_subtotal_cents
          ),

        'calculated_total_cents',
          greatest(
            et.subtotal_before_discount_cents
            - least(
                greatest(et.discount_cents, 0),
                et.entries_subtotal_cents
              ),
            0
          )
      ) as fee_snapshot

    from exhibitor_totals et

    left join public.exhibitors ex
      on ex.id = et.exhibitor_id
  ),

  upserted as (
    insert into public.show_exhibitor_balances (
      show_id,
      exhibitor_id,
      exhibitor_user_id,
      entry_cart_id,
      cart_id,
      currency,
      entry_count,
      fur_count,
      entries_subtotal_cents,
      fur_subtotal_cents,
      show_fee_subtotal_cents,
      subtotal_before_discount_cents,
      discount_cents,
      calculated_total_cents,
      paid_online_cents,
      paid_manual_cents,
      refunded_cents,
      balance_due_cents,
      payment_status,
      latest_show_payment_id,
      latest_checkout_session_id,
      latest_payment_intent_id,
      section_breakdown,
      fee_snapshot,
      source,
      calculated_at,
      updated_at
    )
    select
      v_show_id,
      fr.exhibitor_id,
      fr.exhibitor_user_id,
      p_cart_id,
      p_cart_id,
      v_currency,
      fr.entry_count,
      fr.fur_count,
      fr.entries_subtotal_cents,
      fr.fur_subtotal_cents,
      fr.show_fee_subtotal_cents,
      fr.subtotal_before_discount_cents,
      fr.discount_cents,
      fr.calculated_total_cents,
      0,
      0,
      0,
      fr.calculated_total_cents,

      case
        when fr.calculated_total_cents <= 0 then 'paid'
        else 'unpaid'
      end,

      null,
      null,
      null,
      fr.section_breakdown,
      fr.fee_snapshot,
      'cart',
      now(),
      now()

    from final_rows fr

    on conflict (entry_cart_id, exhibitor_id)
      where (
        entry_cart_id is not null
        and exhibitor_id is not null
        and source = 'cart'
      )

    do update set
      show_id = excluded.show_id,
      exhibitor_user_id = excluded.exhibitor_user_id,
      cart_id = excluded.cart_id,
      currency = excluded.currency,
      entry_count = excluded.entry_count,
      fur_count = excluded.fur_count,
      entries_subtotal_cents =
        excluded.entries_subtotal_cents,
      fur_subtotal_cents =
        excluded.fur_subtotal_cents,
      show_fee_subtotal_cents =
        excluded.show_fee_subtotal_cents,
      subtotal_before_discount_cents =
        excluded.subtotal_before_discount_cents,
      discount_cents =
        excluded.discount_cents,
      calculated_total_cents =
        excluded.calculated_total_cents,
      paid_online_cents = 0,
      paid_manual_cents = 0,
      refunded_cents = 0,
      balance_due_cents =
        excluded.calculated_total_cents,

      payment_status = case
        when excluded.calculated_total_cents <= 0 then 'paid'
        else 'unpaid'
      end,

      latest_show_payment_id = null,
      latest_checkout_session_id = null,
      latest_payment_intent_id = null,
      section_breakdown =
        excluded.section_breakdown,
      fee_snapshot =
        excluded.fee_snapshot,
      source = 'cart',
      calculated_at = now(),
      updated_at = now()

    returning public.show_exhibitor_balances.*
  )

  select *
  from upserted
  order by exhibitor_id;
end;
